title: A particle in the plane: tangent line, direction, acceleration and distance

stimulus.title: A particle with given velocity components
stimulus.html:
A particle moves in the xyxy-plane for 0≤t≤50 \le t \le 5. Its velocity components are given below, and at time t=2t = 2 the particle is at the point (3,−1)(3, -1). A graphing calculator is required.
Velocity components of the particle and its position at t=2t = 2
QuantityValue
dxdt\frac{dx}{dt}t+1\sqrt{t + 1}
dydt\frac{dy}{dt}3cos⁡(1.2t)−13\cos(1.2t) - 1
(x(2),y(2))(x(2), y(2))(3,−1)(3, -1)

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the slope of the path of the particle at time t=2t = 2. Write an equation for the line tangent to the path at the point where t=2t = 2.

rubric.point: Slope: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{t=2}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{y'(2)}{x'(2)}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1.855</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx -1.855</annotation></semantics></math>.

Tangent line through <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(3, -1)</annotation></semantics></math> with that slope: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1.855</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = -1 - 1.855(x - 3)</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: any equivalent form with the slope from the first point

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{t=2}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2.4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{3\cos(2.4) - 1}{\sqrt{3}}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1.855</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx -1.855</annotation></semantics></math>. The tangent line at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(3, -1)</annotation></semantics></math> is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1.855</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = -1 - 1.855(x - 3)</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: For 0<t<50 < t < 5, on what open interval is the yy-coordinate of the particle decreasing? Give a reason for your answer.

rubric.point: Considers the sign of <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math> and finds where <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.2</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3\cos(1.2t) - 1 = 0</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>1.026</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 1.026</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>4.210</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 4.210</annotation></semantics></math>.

Answer with reason: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y</annotation></semantics></math> is decreasing on <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1.026</mn><mo><</mo><mi>t</mi><mo><</mo><mn>4.210</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1.026 < t < 4.210</annotation></semantics></math> because <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt} < 0</annotation></semantics></math> there.
accept: a sign chart of dy/dt with a sentence stating that y is decreasing because dy/dt < 0 on the interval (a sign chart alone does not earn the point)
a reason based on dy/dx earns no credit

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y</annotation></semantics></math> is decreasing where <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.2</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 3\cos(1.2t) - 1 < 0</annotation></semantics></math>. The calculator gives <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt} = 0</annotation></semantics></math> at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>1.026</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 1.026</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>4.210</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 4.210</annotation></semantics></math>, with <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt} < 0</annotation></semantics></math> between them. So the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y</annotation></semantics></math>-coordinate is decreasing on <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1.026</mn><mo><</mo><mi>t</mi><mo><</mo><mn>4.210</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1.026 < t < 4.210</annotation></semantics></math>, because <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt} < 0</annotation></semantics></math> on that interval.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration vector of the particle at time t=2t = 2.

rubric.point: Horizontal component: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">″</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≈</mo><mn>0.289</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x''(2) \approx 0.289</annotation></semantics></math>.

Vertical component: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">″</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2.432</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y''(2) \approx -2.432</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="bold">a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathbf{a}(2)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟨</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">″</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">″</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \left\langle x''(2), y''(2) \right\rangle</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟨</mo><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3.6</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2.4</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \left\langle \frac{1}{2\sqrt{3}}, -3.6\sin(2.4) \right\rangle</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟨</mo><mrow><mn>0.289</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2.432</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">⟩</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx \left\langle 0.289, -2.432 \right\rangle</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Find the total distance traveled by the particle over the time interval 0≤t≤50 \le t \le 5. Find the xx-coordinate of the particle's position at time t=5t = 5.

rubric.point: Distance setup: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>5</mn></msubsup><msqrt><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^5 \sqrt{(x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2}\,dt</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: the definite integral from 0 to 5 of the speed, with dt

rubric.point: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x(5)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 3</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">+</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>2</mn><mn>5</mn></msubsup><msqrt><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msqrt><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+ \int_2^5 \sqrt{t + 1}\,dt</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mn>9.334</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 9.334</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: x(2) plus the integral from 2 to 5 of dx/dt

parts.sample: Distance <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>5</mn></msubsup><msqrt><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.2</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \int_0^5 \sqrt{(t + 1) + (3\cos(1.2t) - 1)^2}\,dt</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mn>14.322</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 14.322</annotation></semantics></math>. Position: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x(5)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= x(2)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">+</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>2</mn><mn>5</mn></msubsup><msqrt><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msqrt><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+ \int_2^5 \sqrt{t + 1}\,dt</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 3</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">+</mo><mn>6.334</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+ 6.334</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mn>9.334</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 9.334</annotation></semantics></math>.
